items.prompt: What belongs in deterministic replay inputs?

options.text: Current clock values and fresh randomness may be read without recording them
options.why: Those unrecorded inputs can change the reconstructed state; record them or remove them from the reducer.

options.text: Ordered events, initial state, reducer/version and relevant rules
options.why: Unrecorded external values/clocks can change results.

options.text: Only the final total, without any events
options.why: That cannot establish the replay path.

items.explanation: Reproduce the actual data and rules that determine the result.
